paper/: An introduction to Pasadena’s Colorado Street Bridge, its 1913 opening, 1993 restoration, and place in the city’s history.
paper/2017-2018/: How Pasadena installed temporary fencing in 2017 and 2018, formed a task force, and reconsidered the bridge’s earlier safety measures.
paper/2018-2019/: Pasadena chose a permanent physical barrier in 2018 and approved a design contract in 2019, with construction dependent on additional funding.
paper/2021/: The 2021 mockups, survey, and committee debate that ended with requests for more design work, community input, and analysis.
paper/2022/: How Pasadena restarted the barrier design process in 2022 and hired a new consultant in April 2023 after repeating its search for proposals.
paper/2023/: Three new barrier concepts reached committee review in 2023, alongside renewed questions about netting, landscaping, staffing, and prevention.
paper/2024/: Pasadena’s 2024 reviews brought netting and rescue analysis, patrol costs, survey results, and further debate over the permanent barrier.
paper/questions/: Compare earlier findings on netting, landscaping, patrols, technology, and prevention with what Pasadena’s July 2024 review added or restated.
paper/2025-2026/: Follow the 2025–2026 schedule changes, budget transfers, and funding discussions, including the June 2028 target for completing design.
paper/forecasts/: Compare Pasadena’s published barrier-project forecasts with later records, distinguishing design, committee review, and construction milestones.
paper/delays/: The documented design, procurement, pandemic, and funding difficulties behind the barrier project, alongside repeated discussions and progress.
paper/where-that-leaves-pasadena/: What the reviewed records suggest about retaining effective protection at Colorado Street Bridge while permanent design and funding remain unsettled.
paper/in-memory/: A dedication to the people who died by suicide at the Colorado Street Bridge, with information about the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline.
paper/sources/: The City records, recordings, research, and historical accounts behind the paper, with source qualifications and links back to the passages they support.
